messages:
maya: quick heads-up — citrine-v0.1 (float -> int8) bring-up showing weird subtoken noise on mixed JA/ZH prompts, and some RTL bracket flipping when Arabic fragments are present. reproducible on staging.
kenji: can you paste a minimal repro prompt + output?
maya: sure — repro prompt: "翻译成中文: 今日はいい天気です。 also: مرحبا (note brackets)"
maya: float baseline (citrine-v0.1_fp16) -> 
  - en->ja/zh BLEU baseline: 31.2
  - mixed JA/ZH samples look fine on fp16
maya: int8 quantized (citrine-v0.1_q8f) output -> 
  - BLEU: 26.5 on same eval set
  - sample outputs show extra subtoken fragments like "今日##は" vs "今日は" and stray ZWJ/BRACKET order when Arabic 
kenji: interesting, is this appearing at generation boundary or in detokenization step?
li-wei: I ran a quick diff on token ids. quant path seems to change top-k logits around CJK punctuation and ZWJ. example token ids (fp16 vs q8):
```
fp16: [12345, 678, 3456]  // corresponds to [今日, は, 。]
q8f:  [12345,  12, 678, 3456] // extra subtoken inserted
```
sam: did you use the same tokenizer version and merge table? sometimes merges get normalized differently during conversion.
maya: yes, tokenizer v2.1 pinned in model card. I re-ran with tokenizer_v2.1 and again with the raw vocab; same problem. Also saw Arabic bracket order flip only in q8 runs when mixing RTL sequence mid-embedding.
sam: could be KV cache alignment bug triggered by quant noise. Any KVCACHE errors in logs?
maya: found this in logs during generation: 
```
WARN runtime::kv_cache: pop index mismatch at step 48 (expected 47)
```
li-wei: that usually points to an off-by-one in continuous batching or a token boundary mismatch. Are you using continuous batching / prefix cache?
maya: yes, staging config uses cont-batching=on and prefix_cache=autowarm. I re-ran with cont-batching disabled and the subtoken noise went away for some samples.
kenji: great data point. so either quantized kernel interacts with cont-batching logic or cache serialization for q8 is slightly different. can you run a micro-batch with cont-batching off and with --dump-kv before/after quant path for a failing sample?
maya: running now. command: `rci infer --model citrine-v0.1_q8f --prompts repro.json --batch-size 1 --cont-batching off --dump-kv kv_dump.json`
deploy-bot: deploy started for citrine-v0.1_q8f -> staging (tag: q8f-2026-03-21-09)
eval-bot: scheduled eval job 2026-03-21_09_12 on multilang-detok-suite (200 samples)
sam: if this reproduces, next step is kernel bisect: run q8 with quant_backend=v1 and v2 (we've seen subtle differences). also try running with `--q_dtype int8` vs `--q_dtype int8_sym`
li-wei: I'll take kernel bisect. kenji, can you help with KV serialization check? maybe cache index uses 32-bit offsets in fp path and 16-bit in q8 path?
kenji: on it. also want to validate tokenization id->string mapping after quantized model export — maybe merge table encoding got re-ordered.
maya: results from dumping KV: when cont-batching on, cache length jumps by 1 after step where mixed-language switch happens. with cont-batching off, stable. attaching small kv diff snippet below:
```
step 47 kv_len: 47 (fp16)
step 47 kv_len: 48 (q8f)
```
li-wei: that aligns with the pop index mismatch. hypothesis: quantized attention kernel writes an extra placeholder to KV on switch of script class (Han -> Arabic). that placeholder then creates a subtoken misalignment which detok later shows as fragment.
sam: what about eval metrics? does chrF show similar drop?
maya: chrF drops 0.09, rougeL -3.2, and a handful of locale-specific buckets (ja-zh-mixed) drop >15% relative. pure ja-only or zh-only unaffected.
kenji: plan: 1) reproduce with cont-batching off -> confirmed. 2) kernel bisect q8 backend v1/v2 -> li-wei 3) KV write path audit for script-switch edge-case -> kenji 4) temporary mitigation: disable cont-batching for q8 models on mixed-script locale routing in staging -> maya/sam to roll config.
sam: I'll add a per-model route rule: if model tag contains `_q8` and request.locale in ["ja-zh-mixed","multiscript-mixed"] then set cont_batch=false. quick patch on console UI plus runtime override.
maya: ok thanks. I'll open a formal triage issue with sample reproducer, kv dumps, eval tarball.
li-wei: starting kernel bisect now, ping when done.
maya: thanks all — will follow up with issue link + failing sample. :thumbsup:
